asked: hi Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /root/axf-builds/orchestrator-vps-gate/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first. VPS actions (Brett, Nov 7 2026): the orchestrator is the only door to the VPS. Never call axHub's vps.run / vps.build_* tools yourself. Send every VPS action through the orchestrator's gate: `node framework/cli/axf.mjs vps run "<command>" --reason "<one plain line>"` (or the console MCP tool build_orchestrator_vps_act). Its policy decides: reads run at once, writes count down for Brett's veto or wait for his approve; `axf vps held` shows what is waiting. Never decide a hold yourself.
